variables.description: The host port for accessing the Paperless-ngx web interface.
variables.label: Paperless-ngx Web Port

variables.description: The name of the PostgreSQL database used by Paperless-ngx.
variables.label: Paperless Database Name

variables.description: The username for accessing the PostgreSQL database.
variables.label: Paperless Database User

variables.description: The password for the PostgreSQL database user.
variables.label: Paperless Database Password

variables.description: A unique secret key used for cryptographic signing in Paperless-ngx. Keep this secure.
variables.label: Paperless Secret Key

variables.description: The User ID (UID) that the Paperless-ngx container will use. Set to 0 for root, or match your host user for permission consistency.
variables.label: User ID (UID)

variables.description: The Group ID (GID) that the Paperless-ngx container will use. Set to 0 for root, or match your host group for permission consistency.
variables.label: Group ID (GID)

variables.description: Specify the timezone for the container (e.g., Europe/Berlin, America/New_York).
variables.label: Timezone
